Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Judge Questions Google AI, Spam Update Fallout – SEO Pulse
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: This week's SEO Pulse covers Google's AI publisher dispute, spam update fallout, the GEO debate, AI citation gaps, and ChatGPT's Reddit behavior in search. The roundup touches on multiple intersecting issues relevant to enterprise SEO and AI search visibility strategy.

AI Search / GEO.title: Google Further Buries Search Results Under AI Mode
AI Search / GEO.summary: Google is expanding AI Overviews so they auto-expand and push traditional organic search results further down the page. This is a direct structural change to how organic results are surfaced and has immediate implications for enterprise click-through rates.

AI Search / GEO.title: What 9 Months of AI Overview Data and 51,000+ Tracked Events Reveal
AI Search / GEO.summary: Search Engine Land presents findings drawn from over 51,000 tracked AI Overview events across nine months of data collection. The scale of the dataset makes this a high-signal resource for understanding AI Overview behavior patterns at an enterprise level.

AI Search / GEO.title: Google AI Overviews Cut Search Clicks 42%: Report
AI Search / GEO.summary: A report cited by Search Engine Land finds that Google AI Overviews are associated with a significant reduction in organic search clicks. This headline figure is directly relevant to enterprise SEO teams tracking AI Overview impact on traffic.

AI Search / GEO.title: Google AI Overviews CTR Shows Early Signs of Recovery: Study
AI Search / GEO.summary: A study reported by Search Engine Land identifies early signs that click-through rates are beginning to recover in queries affected by AI Overviews. This provides an important counterpoint to prior click-loss reports and is actionable for enterprise performance benchmarking.

AI Search / GEO.title: Google AI Overviews Now Appear on 14% of Shopping Queries: Report
AI Search / GEO.summary: According to a report covered by Search Engine Land, Google AI Overviews are now present on a notable share of shopping-related queries. This is particularly relevant for travel and commerce-adjacent enterprise verticals monitoring AI Overview expansion.

AI Search / GEO.title: Mastering Generative Engine Optimization in 2026: Full Guide
AI Search / GEO.summary: Search Engine Land publishes a comprehensive guide to Generative Engine Optimization covering strategies for maintaining visibility in AI-generated answer surfaces. As a full guide from a credible trade publication, it serves as a practical GEO reference for enterprise teams.
